items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: Pops Foster? Well, I don't exactly remember, you know, who they were.

ctx.x: Well, that's that Louis Russell bunch, aren't we?

That's King Oliver's bunch, you see? They double-crossed King, and that's where Russell got the bunch. Something came up there, and that's where I think they all swung with Russell. That's the whole bunch that was with King when he came there to New York. Pops Foster? Well, I don't exactly remember, you know, who they were.
I see here in the book you got Lizzie Miles and her Creole jazz hands on Emerson. Four O'clock Blues and Aggravating Papa. You remember anything about that record?
